mobbin:f28f8936-895b-450a-8e9b-5a83c12ba.summary: The presenter starts a live session on the big screen, where a QR code and a short code let the audience join. The join banner can then be hidden while the session stays live.
steps: Live QR banner and side panel
steal: People can join through a large QR code, the canva.live address or a short code, which helps in rooms where phones struggle to scan (screen 2).
A live count of participants next to 'End session' shows the presenter that people have joined (screen 2).
Hide and Show on the join strip clear the join details from the public display once people are connected (screens 2 to 3).
'Copy invitation' gives people who join remotely or late a way in without the QR code (screen 2).
avoid: This flow shows only the big-screen side, with no phone notes or remote screens, so it is weak evidence for private faculty annotations.
mobbin:f28f8936-895b-450a-8e9b-5a83c12ba.fit: Debrief and review: a strong pattern for the QR code on the debrief-room screen after recording. The public display shows the video and join details for a short time; the phone would hold the private annotations.

mobbin:f2fe9686-5232-45d6-816e-8d7d99eae.summary: From a presentation on the phone, the user opens remote control with a QR code and a link to copy, to hand control to another device, with a pause option.
steal: The title 'Remote control this presentation' says what the screen is for in one line (screen 2).
An 'Available' status and a Pause control let the presenter switch off the remote link without ending the session (screen 2).
A 'Copy link' next to the QR code covers phones or tablets that fail to scan in a debrief room (screen 2).
avoid: The flow shows only the phone, never the big screen it controls, so Essentials still needs both sides designed before this counts as strong second-screen evidence.
mobbin:f2fe9686-5232-45d6-816e-8d7d99eae.fit: Debrief and review: maps to the faculty phone as a private remote for the room display. Pair it with the web Live QR flow so both sides are designed.
